children: Incyte announced an agreement with CMS to provide Jakafi and Jakafi XR to state Medicaid programs at prices aligned with a set of other advanced nations.
Incyte will enable state Medicaid access to Jakafi and Jakafi XR at prices aligned with a defined group of advanced, industrialized nations.
Under the agreement, Incyte expects not to be subject to certain future CMS pricing mandates, including the proposed GUARD and GLOBE models.
Company does not expect the agreement to affect its 2026 financial guidance or have a material impact on its future financial outlook.
